query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

WanAnimate crashes ComfyUI with CUDA IndexKernel 'index out of bounds' assertions even with torchcompile off and lightx2v lora off, when loading theAnimate model as GGUF in WanVideoModelLoader.

desired.outcome: Confirmed by another user + OP: 'CompiledKernel has no attribute launch_enter_hook' triton mismatch — solved by downgrading Triton and then permanently with the next day's WanVideoWrapper release.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Confirmed by another user + OP: 'CompiledKernel has no attribute launch_enter_hook' triton mismatch — solved by downgrading Triton and then permanently with the next day's WanVideoWrapper release.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Untangle a CUDA IndexKernel assert into a triton/torch version mismatch (CompiledKernel launch_enter_hook) and resolve via triton downgrade or wrapper update.
